description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Hadirawalana Pahalagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/0216)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and land registration particulars. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and other property-related details, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
